title: Mbo language (Congo)
description: Language of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
extract: The Mbo language is spoken by the Mbo people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In 1994 there were about 11,000 speakers. It is lexically similar to the Ndaka and Budu, Vanuma and Nyali languages.
